bear_case.summary: PODD is down ~62% from its high because the growth story broke: 2026 revenue outlook cut ($3.2-3.3B) on slower US pump sales, higher early attrition and lower utilization in type 2, plus a manufacturing correction (insulin under-delivery risk) and a securities class action. A 20x forward multiple is not cheap if growth decelerates to medtech-average and quality issues persist; GLP-1s and competition (Tandem, Medtronic, Beta Bionics patch pumps) add structural risk.
